coverage.topic: where care happens, referrals, pre-existing conditions
coverage.statement: Care happens at the Yale Health Center unless your primary care clinician refers you outside. Prior authorization is required for all referrals to outside clinicians or specialists. There are no pre-existing condition limitations.

Cost-sharing depends on your plan group. The groups are: Faculty, Post-Doctoral Associates and Fellows, and Managerial & Professional; Clerical & Technical Staff, Service & Maintenance Staff, and Yale Security; and Yale Police Benevolent Association (YPBA). This app does not know which group you are in. Member Services can tell you.
coverage.source: Yale Health coverage page and Member Booklet 2026, plan group tables

coverage.topic: departments you can see without an authorization
coverage.statement: You can go directly, without an authorization, to Acute Care, Internal Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Ophthalmology and Pediatrics at the Yale Health Center, 55 Lock Street. All other departments and services require prior authorization.

coverage.topic: choosing a different plan after three years (Clerical & Technical, Service & Maintenance, and Security staff only)
coverage.statement: Applies to Clerical & Technical, Service & Maintenance, and Security staff only. After three years of service, these employees may remain a member of Yale Health or, if eligible, enroll in either Aetna Smart Care with a Health Savings Account (HSA) or Aetna Select. This is not general staff and faculty coverage. Faculty and Managerial & Professional staff are not covered by this rule; ask Member Services.
coverage.source: Yale benefits page 'Medical, Dental, & Vision' (It's Your Yale), under the Clerical & Technical, Service & Maintenance, Security classification. Not the booklet or the Yale Health coverage page.
coverage.scope: Clerical & Technical, Service & Maintenance, and Security staff only
coverage.quote: "After you complete three years of service, you may remain a member of Yale Health" ... "eligible staff can enroll in either Aetna Smart Care with a Health Savings Account (HSA) or Aetna Select"

coverage.statement: Physical therapy and occupational therapy are covered when medically necessary and prescribed by a physician as part of a written plan of care. Yale Health may limit the number of sessions or the duration of treatment. Cost per visit by plan group: Faculty, Post-Doctoral Associates and Fellows, and Managerial & Professional: $20 copay per visit (in-network providers, including PTSMC locations). Clerical & Technical, Service & Maintenance, and Yale Security: covered at 100%. YPBA: covered at 100%. PTSMC at Yale Health is at 55 Lock Street, New Haven.

Hospital emergency facility copay per visit: Faculty, Post-Doctoral Associates and Fellows, and Managerial & Professional: $150, waived if admitted. Clerical & Technical, Service & Maintenance, and Yale Security: $50, waived if you notify Yale Health within 48 hours at 877-947-2273. YPBA: $70, with the same waiver. Non-emergency care in a hospital emergency room is not covered.

Urgent medical care at Yale Health Acute Care: Faculty, Post-Doctoral Associates and Fellows, and Managerial & Professional: covered at 100% Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-6 p.m., $20 copay from 6 p.m.-10 p.m., weekends, and University holidays and recess days. Clerical & Technical, Service & Maintenance, Yale Security, and YPBA: covered at 100%.

Outpatient behavioral health services by in-network mental health professionals are covered at 100% for recognized behavioral health and substance abuse disorders across all plan groups, subject to exclusions and limitations. Outpatient services require prior authorization from, and are accessed through, Magellan Healthcare at 800-327-9240.
